commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search Eurostat datasets by keyword (autocomplete suggestions). Returns dataset codes with highlighted titles.

commands.name: list-all-datasets
commands.summary: List every Eurostat dataflow (code, title, last data/structure update). Set comext=true for the Comext (international trade) database. Large response.

commands.name: list-themes
commands.summary: List top-level statistical themes (navigation tree roots). crossCutting=true returns the cross-cutting / EU-policy themes instead.

commands.name: get-theme-navtree
commands.summary: Get the category navigation tree under a theme (e.g. popul = Population and social conditions).

commands.name: get-full-tree
commands.summary: Get the full Eurostat navigation tree (categories and datasets), optionally only the branch under one category code.

commands.name: list-category-datasets
commands.summary: List the datasets in a navigation-tree category (e.g. scheme popul, category une = unemployment), with titles, update dates and links.

commands.name: get-dataset-info
commands.summary: Get dataset metadata: title, description, observation count, time coverage, last data/structure update, DOI, source dataset, metadata links.

commands.name: get-dataset-status
commands.summary: Check that a dataset code exists and has data; returns its canonical id, default view id and last data/structure update timestamps (ms).

commands.name: get-dataset-dimensions
commands.summary: List a dataset's dimensions (freq, geo, sex, age, unit, ...) with all available codes and labels. Use these codes as filters in get-data.

commands.name: get-dataset-categories
commands.summary: Get where a dataset sits in the navigation tree (theme and category breadcrumbs).

commands.name: get-dataset-relations
commands.summary: List datasets derived from this dataset and the source dataset(s) it is derived from (code -> title).

commands.name: get-data
commands.summary: Fetch dataset values as JSON-stat from the public statistics API, filtered by dimension codes (geo, sex, age, unit, s_adj, na_item, ...) and time range.

commands.name: get-codelist
commands.summary: Get all codes and labels of a Eurostat codelist (e.g. geo = countries/regions/aggregates).
